hooks.text: 用机车、车厢与驾驶员组装列车，同时决定本局起始牌组
hooks.excerpt: Choose from a variety of locomotives, carriages, and drivers to lead your expedition, with each decision adding a different set of cards to your starting deck, impacting the options and abilities you’ll have access to throughout your run.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用煤与炮击把敌车推上铁轨碾碎，再引发整列车辆连环相撞
hooks.excerpt: A clever use of Coal combined with a well placed Artillery Shot can force an enemy onto the tracks in front of you, only to be immediately crushed under your wheels. That same Artillery Shot could be used to destroy a leading vehicle and send it tumbling backwards to damage (and possibly destroy) everyone driving behind it, potentially paired with hacking cards that give you a chance to line more vehicles up first.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 按区域修正与节点风险规划支线，在战场和维修站之间选择列车路线
hooks.excerpt: Travel from region to region as you race to the edge of the fog, picking and choosing your path depending on a region’s specific modifiers and special rewards on offer. Branching paths within a region further allow you to finetune your route to the final destination based on the risks and rewards presented by each node along the way, ranging from battlefields to friendly waystations where you can upgrade and repair your train.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
